caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile pattern composed of blue, orange, and beige colors. The design features a central square area dominated by a dense grid of small dark blue squares on a beige background, interspersed with a smaller proportion of black squares. This central area is surrounded by a border formed from alternating segments of solid blue and blue checkered oval-shaped patterns. Flanking the central area on the left and right sides are two wide vertical stripes made of closely-spaced orange horizontal bands with thin intermittent turquoise-blue horizontal stripes and small vertical columns of blue ovals. The outer edges of the textile contain a blue grid of small ovals arranged regularly on a beige background. The entire woven composition is set against an off-white background with the signature "Christoffels" in the lower right corner.
title: Coverlet (Reverse Side)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
